A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same theoretical work, retaining the problem, two algorithms and main regret guarantees. All 16 pages of v6 and 20 pages of v7 are readable, including v7's Appendix A. Proofs moved into the appendix can be matched to v6.

before.justification: v6 reports algorithms and theoretical regret analysis, but no original experimental, simulation, user-study or data-analysis outcomes.

after.justification: v7's main text and Appendix A contain theoretical analysis only; no original empirical outcomes are reported.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 changes the master's learning rate from 1/√(TK) to 1/√(TH), where H is the number of bases. The sampling, loss estimators, clipping and Algorithm 2's adaptive updates otherwise remain unchanged after matching renamed learning-rate notation.

E1.justification: Neither version uses datasets or conducts empirical evaluations. The theoretical unknown-switch adversarial bandit setting and its stochastic extension remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Neither version reports experimental baseline evaluations. Discussions of EXP3.S and BOB compare theoretical guarantees rather than evaluated empirical comparator sets.

E3.justification: Neither version reports experimental splits, evaluation metrics, training budgets or testing procedures. The changed master learning rate belongs to the proposed algorithm.

E4.justification: Neither version contains ablations, robustness tests, sensitivity experiments or empirical case studies. The added appendix supplies proofs.

E5.justification: Neither reports repeated runs, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. The variance terms concern theoretical loss estimators, not empirical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Neither version reports measured scores or qualitative experimental findings. The revisions concern analytical regret calculations rather than observed outcomes.

T1.justification: Beyond relocating proofs, v7 adds derivations for previously cited lemmas as Lemmas A.1, A.2 and A.4, revises expectation/maximization and adaptive-rate telescoping arguments, and changes the master variance term from ηTK/2 to ηTH/2. It removes v6 Section 2.1's Ω(√SKT) lower-bound derivation. The added Lemma A.4 proof also inconsistently defines a negative-entropy regularizer while using log-barrier identities.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain two master-base OMD algorithms for unknown S with the same claimed asymptotic regret rates. v7's formulation using ρ ≥ E[ρ_T(h†)] restates a bound already obtained through Jensen's inequality in v6, page 14.

C2.justification: Remark 3.6 newly acknowledges that uniform mixing is not exact Bregman projection and lacks a corresponding regret analysis. Remark 3.5 adds guidance about choosing between the algorithms in large-S and large-T regimes. Earlier explicit open-problem statements about worst-case optimality and further variance analysis are omitted.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1's documented initialization changes, and Remark 3.6 clarifies the status of the existing uniform-mixing implementation recipe. The displayed implementation formulas otherwise remain equivalent after time-index changes; no code, data, hardware or runtime information is added.

R1.justification: The same 15 cited works remain, but v7 removes explicit unknown-S EXP3.S comparisons and emphasizes BOB. It also more directly relates its variance-dependent analysis to Luo et al. (2022), emphasizing worst-case control without knowing S.

P1.justification: The introduction, problem formulation and OMD explanations are extensively rewritten. Detailed main-text proofs become sketches organized around base, master and overall regret, with full derivations in Appendix A. Remarks, notation, author information and acknowledgements are also revised.

P2.justification: v7 adopts a document-wide TMLR layout with a redesigned title and author block, running headers, different typography and text area, and reflowed equations and algorithm boxes. Algorithm 1 loses its line numbers. Neither version contains data figures or results tables.

improvement.justification: v7 improves exposition, corrects Algorithm 1's master-rate and variance calculation, and adds a useful implementation qualification. However, its new Lemma A.4 proof defines negative entropy while Algorithm 2 and subsequent identities require a log barrier. This inconsistency affects the added support for a central guarantee, so the documentation gains and theoretical reliability concerns do not permit a confident net quality judgment.
